_comment: Per-segment scenarios for the semantic 'time to process one 5-minute segment' benchmark. Each scenario is a recipe of (a) audio length (always 5 min by definition), (b) qualified screen-recording frames that get described, (c) per-segment talent invocations, and (d) a fixed overhead constant covering frame decode + orchestration that doesn't fit a tok/s model. Frame counts and talent lists are inspectable approximations sourced from the live pipeline (observe/describe.py dHash threshold + talent/ schedule:segment files); retune as the pipeline changes. Talent counts default to 1; conditional talents include an 'optional_reason' for the inclusion/exclusion rationale.

solo_active.label: Solo active
solo_active.description: Solo coding/reading session, no meeting. Active screen activity, single speaker.

talents.optional_reason: fires when sense reports density=active and recommends screen recording

meeting_active.label: Meeting
meeting_active.description: Meeting transcript with multiple speakers; sparse screen activity (focus on conversation).

talents.optional_reason: runs only when sense reports meeting_detected=true

idle.label: Idle
idle.description: Minimal activity (idle desktop, no conversation). Housekeeping talents still run.
